_: The core genre set. Human-readable voice lives in genres/GENRES.md; this file is what the engine checks. A repo extends or overrides it under `genres` in kit.json — same shape, deep-merged per genre.

note.forbidden: sections, scaffolding, growing past a few paragraphs — promote to an entry

concept.reader: has met the term and wants it pinned down
concept.forbidden: a definition that depends on a running result — the defn must survive findings changing

entry.register: analytical, takes a position, cites findings by id
entry.reader: interested, not expert in this artifact
entry.forbidden: unattributed claims; a wall of prose with no sections to navigate

story.register: plain, sealed to its findings: the question in words, why it was expected to help, what was done, what happened, what was learned, what it does not show, where to go deeper
story.reader: a sharp outsider who has never seen the lab
story.forbidden: a rolling narrative; a lab code as the subject of a sentence; a number without its row id; a caveat the rows bind that is missing from what-it-does-not-show

book.register: the map of a sequence: what the chapters build, in what order, and why
book.reader: deciding whether and where to start
book.forbidden: teaching — the index orients, the chapters teach

chapter.register: pedagogical, second person allowed, one idea at a time
chapter.reader: has read the prior chapters and nothing else
chapter.forbidden: forward references — a link to a later chapter must carry data-fwd to say it is deliberate

hub.forbidden: long prose — a hub that explains is an entry wearing a hub's hat

project.register: the front door: plain sentences and links — what is being asked, what has been learned with each sentence carrying its rows, the top-level bounds, and dated state
project.reader: arriving cold, deciding what to read next
project.forbidden: undated state — the page is explicitly perishable; re-explaining what a story or a concept page owns; a bound that belongs to one result

paper.register: the landing page of a venue artifact: abstract, status, what it cites, where the source is
paper.reader: a reviewer or a reader deciding whether to open the PDF
paper.forbidden: restating the paper — the page frames it, the PDF is the paper

related.register: neutral summary of others' work with the stance kept separate
related.reader: wants to know what others did and why it matters here
related.forbidden: conflating their claim with our reading of it; unverified identifiers
